author: Totally Not Mark
description:
Dragon Ball, Z or Dragon Ball Super aren't exactly known for their CGI. But did you know that CGI has been used in the series as early as 1993? Talk a walk with me as I dive down the CGI rabbit hole to see if I can find every use of it in the series! 

MERCH: https://www.totallynotmark.com
PATREON:  https://www.patreon.com/totallynotmark
title: Every CGI Scene in Dragon Ball (1993 - 2026)
